segments.en: Hello, English learners.
segments.zh: 各位英语学习者，大家好。

segments.en: Welcome back to EnglishPod.
segments.zh: 欢迎回到 EnglishPod。

segments.en: My name is Marco.
segments.zh: 我叫 Marco。

segments.en: And my name is Catherine and today we're talking about being clean.
segments.zh: 我的名字是凯瑟琳，今天我们谈论的是干净。

segments.en: Yeah, we're going to be doing the laundry, right?
segments.zh: 是的，我们要洗衣服，对吧？

segments.en: It's a very important part of everyone's weekly schedule.
segments.zh: 这是每个人每周日程安排中非常重要的一部分。

segments.en: And not only important, but I find it to be a little bit difficult because, you know, like washing machine and what clothes you should mix with what, you know, how much detergent and how long.
segments.zh: 不仅很重要，而且我发现这有点困难，因为，你知道，你知道，你应该把什么衣服和什么衣服和什么衣服混合起来，你知道，洗涤剂有多少和多长时间。

segments.en: It's such a complicated process.
segments.zh: 这是一个如此复杂的过程。

segments.en: Well, let's say this, it might not be difficult, but it's very easy to mess up.
segments.zh: 好吧，假设这可能并不难，但很容易搞砸。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: Yeah, that's the problem.
segments.zh: 是的，这就是问题所在。

segments.en: It's very easy to like just ruin your favorite t-shirt if you don't do laundry correctly.
segments.zh: 如果你没有正确洗衣服，很容易就毁了你最喜欢的 T 恤。

segments.en: Or all of your white socks turn pink, for example.
segments.zh: 例如，或者你所有的白袜子变成粉红色。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So we're going to be looking at a lot of vocabulary and phrases related to this topic.
segments.zh: 因此，我们将研究与此主题相关的许多词汇和短语。

segments.en: And before we get started with the dialogue, why don't we take a look at vocabulary preview?
segments.zh: 在我们开始对话之前，我们为什么不看看词汇预览呢？

segments.en: Vocabulary preview.
segments.zh: 词汇预习。

segments.en: Okay, so central to all of these phrases and words that we're going to be hearing is a thing, an electric thing that helps us wash our clothes.
segments.zh: 好吧，对于我们将要听到的所有这些短语和单词的核心是一个东西，一种帮助我们洗衣服的电动东西。

segments.en: Right, a washing machine.
segments.zh: 对了，洗衣机。

segments.en: Right, pretty simple, right?
segments.zh: 对，很简单，对吧？

segments.en: So washing is to wash, washing and machine.
segments.zh: 所以洗涤是洗涤、洗涤和机器。

segments.en: So they go together, washing machine.
segments.zh: 所以他们一起去，洗衣机。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's easy now, you just put all your clothes in this thing and it washes it for you.
segments.zh: 所以现在很容易，你把所有的衣服都放在这东西里，它就为你洗了。

segments.en: Now, you know, a lot of people don't like to use washing machines.
segments.zh: 现在，你知道，很多人不喜欢使用洗衣机。

segments.en: They say it doesn't really clean the clothes as well as doing it by hand.
segments.zh: 他们说它并没有真正清洁衣服，也不像手工那样清洁衣服。

segments.en: Really?
segments.zh: 真的吗？

segments.en: Well, I'd say most clothes get washed pretty well with a washing machine.
segments.zh: 好吧，我想说大多数衣服都用洗衣机洗得很好。

segments.en: But if you have those hard to get stains or some dirt, maybe it's good to have a washing board.
segments.zh: 但是，如果您有那些难以弄脏的污渍或一些污垢，也许有一块洗衣板是件好事。

segments.en: A washing board, yeah.
segments.zh: 一块洗衣机，是的。

segments.en: Yeah, where you can really scrub it yourself.
segments.zh: 是的，你可以自己擦洗的地方。

segments.en: And well, funny you mentioned that word stain because it's our second word that we're going to preview, a stain.
segments.zh: 好吧，有趣的是，您提到了这个词污点，因为这是我们要预览的第二个词，一个污点。

segments.en: Right, a stain is some color, maybe some food or wine or grass that you can't remove from your clothes.
segments.zh: 是的，污渍是某种颜色，可能是一些你无法从衣服上取下的食物、葡萄酒或草。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it's very common.
segments.zh: 所以这很常见。

segments.en: You're having a nice dinner and all of a sudden you spill wine on your shirt.
segments.zh: 你吃了一顿丰盛的晚餐，突然间你把酒洒在你的衬衫上。

segments.en: So you have a wine stain.
segments.zh: 所以你有酒渍。

segments.en: I hate that.
segments.zh: 我讨厌那样。

segments.en: And you can also have stain on your, you can also have a stain on your carpet, right?
segments.zh: 你也可以在你的地毯上有污渍，你也可以在你的地毯上有污渍吗？

segments.en: So if you spill some coffee on your carpet, it's got a little circle that's brown forever.
segments.zh: 所以如果你在地毯上洒了一些咖啡，它就会有一个永远棕色的小圆圈。

segments.en: Right?
segments.zh: 对吧？

segments.en: Or even some people have stained the teeth, right?
segments.zh: 甚至有些人已经弄脏了牙齿，对吧？

segments.en: That's right.
segments.zh: 没错。

segments.en: So you can get them turned back white with a little money to your dentist.
segments.zh: 所以你可以用一点钱把它们变成白色的牙医。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So those are the two words that we're going to be looking at today in Vocabulary Preview.
segments.zh: 所以这是我们今天将在词汇预览中看到的两个词。

segments.en: So let's listen to our dialogue.
segments.zh: 所以让我们听听我们的对话。

segments.en: Let's see what's happening with these people that are doing laundry.
segments.zh: 让我们看看这些洗衣服的人发生了什么事。

segments.en: Okay, let's go through this one more time.
segments.zh: 好吧，让我们再来一次。

segments.en: I don't want any more ruined or dyed blouses.
segments.zh: 我可不想再把衬衫洗坏或染上别的颜色了。

segments.en: I know, I know.
segments.zh: 我知道，我知道。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I had to separate the colors from the whites and put them in this strange looking contraption so-called washing machine.
segments.zh: 所以我得把彩色衣服和白色衣服分开，再放进这个样子古怪、叫作洗衣机的机器里。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You have to turn it on and program it depending on what type of clothes you're washing.
segments.zh: 你得打开机器，再根据所洗衣物的类型选择洗涤程序。

segments.en: For example, for delicates, you should set a shorter washing cycle.
segments.zh: 比如洗精细衣物时，应该选择较短的洗涤程序。

segments.en: Also be sure to use fabric softener and this detergent when washing.
segments.zh: 洗的时候还要记得加衣物柔顺剂和这种洗涤剂。

segments.en: So complicated.
segments.zh: 太复杂了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: What about this red wine stain?
segments.zh: 这个红酒污渍怎么办？

segments.en: How do I get it out?
segments.zh: 这污渍怎么洗掉？

segments.en: Since this is a white t-shirt, you can just pour a little bit of bleach on it and it will do the trick.
segments.zh: 因为这是一件白色的 T 恤，你可以在上面倒一点漂白剂，它就可以了。

segments.en: Cool.
segments.zh: 太好了。

segments.en: Then I can just throw everything in the dryer for an hour and it's all set, right?
segments.zh: 然后把衣服全扔进烘干机，烘一小时就行了，对吧？

segments.en: No.
segments.zh: 不。

segments.en: Since you're washing delicates and cotton, you should set the dryer to medium heat and for 20 minutes.
segments.zh: 你洗的是精细衣物和棉质衣服，所以烘干机应该设为中温，烘二十分钟。

segments.en: You know what?
segments.zh: 你知道吗？

segments.en: I'll just have everything dry cleaned.
segments.zh: 我干脆把所有衣服都送去干洗好了。

segments.en: Okay, so we've got someone who is maybe doing the laundry for the first time and he's not really understanding the instructions he's got.
segments.zh: 好吧，所以我们有一个人可能是第一次洗衣服，但他并没有真正理解他得到的指示。

segments.en: Well, that's the thing I tell you.
segments.zh: 嗯，这就是我告诉你的。

segments.en: It's a little bit difficult and well, it's very tedious at times to try and do laundry like this.
segments.zh: 这有点困难而且很好，有时尝试像这样洗衣服很乏味。

segments.en: Well, the first thing that's maybe tedious about it is that you have to really worry about what colors go together.
segments.zh: 好吧，第一件事可能是乏味的，你必须真正担心什么颜色会搭配在一起。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So let's take a look at those words that were related to doing laundry now in Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 所以让我们来看看那些与现在在语言外卖中洗衣服有关的词。

segments.en: Language Takeaway.
segments.zh: 语言要点。

segments.en: Okay, the first word we have is actually related to a joke we made earlier about pink socks.
segments.zh: 好吧，我们的第一个词实际上与我们之前关于粉红色袜子的笑话有关。

segments.en: So if you change the color of something, you're dying it.
segments.zh: 所以如果你改变某物的颜色，你就死了。

segments.en: Okay, die.
segments.zh: 好吧，死。

segments.en: So it's pronounced exactly the same way as, you know, to die, to not live anymore.
segments.zh: 所以它的发音方式与你知道的、死去的、不再活着的方式完全相同。

segments.en: Die.
segments.zh: 死。

segments.en: But it's spelled differently.
segments.zh: 但拼写不同。

segments.en: D-Y-E.
segments.zh: 拼写是 D-Y-E。

segments.en: Okay, so it can be a verb or an adjective.
segments.zh: 好的，所以它可以是动词或形容词。

segments.en: Or a noun.
segments.zh: 或名词。

segments.en: Or a noun.
segments.zh: 或名词。

segments.en: So something that you put on clothes to change the color is called a dye.
segments.zh: 所以你穿上衣服来改变颜色的东西叫做染料。

segments.en: A dye.
segments.zh: 染料。

segments.en: But to do this, to change the color of some clothes is to dye the clothes.
segments.zh: 但要做到这一点，改变一些衣服的颜色就是给衣服染色。

segments.en: So that's maybe what happens when you wash a red t-shirt with all your white t-shirts.
segments.zh: 所以当你用所有的白色 T 恤洗一件红色 T 恤时，可能会发生这种情况。

segments.en: Then you have dyed shirts.
segments.zh: 然后你有染过的衬衫。

segments.en: You have pink shirts and...
segments.zh: 你有粉红色的衬衫和...

segments.en: And also women, when they go to the beauty salon, they dye their hair.
segments.zh: 还有女性，当她们去美容院时，她们会染头发。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So to change the color of your hair, it means it's a long-term change.
segments.zh: 所以要改变头发的颜色，这意味着它是一个长期的变化。

segments.en: It's not short.
segments.zh: 它不短。

segments.en: It's not like one day.
segments.zh: 这不像是一天。

segments.en: It means probably for a long time.
segments.zh: 这意味着可能持续很长时间。

segments.en: So that's the correct word, to dye.
segments.zh: 所以这是正确的词，染。

segments.en: Very different.
segments.zh: 非常不同。

segments.en: Maybe some people say to paint, which, you know, we understand, but the correct form would be to dye.
segments.zh: 也许有些人说画画，你知道，我们理解，但正确的形式是染色。

segments.en: And next we have a word that describes a certain kind of clothing.
segments.zh: 接下来我们有一个词来描述某种服装。

segments.en: We're not talking about pants or socks.
segments.zh: 我们不是在谈论裤子或袜子。

segments.en: We're talking about delicates.
segments.zh: 我们在谈论熟食。

segments.en: Delicates.
segments.zh: 熟食。

segments.en: So now this adjective, delicate, which means it's very...
segments.zh: 所以现在这个形容词，精致，这意味着它非常...

segments.en: easy to break.
segments.zh: 容易破。

segments.en: Fragile, right?
segments.zh: 脆弱的，对吧？

segments.en: But this is a noun, delicates.
segments.zh: 但这是一个名词，精巧。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So you think of something that's easy to break or to ruin, maybe you think of underwear.
segments.zh: 所以你会想到一些容易折断或毁坏的东西，也许你会想到内衣。

segments.en: Underwear.
segments.zh: 内衣。

segments.en: You know, underwear is something you wear under your clothing and so it's generally not as strong as a shirt or a pair of jeans.
segments.zh: 你知道，内衣是你在衣服下穿的东西，所以它通常不如衬衫或牛仔裤那么坚固。

segments.en: And so we call these in English delicates.
segments.zh: 所以我们用英文熟食来称呼这些。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: So you have to be careful when you're washing your delicates because it's happened to me before.
segments.zh: 所以当你洗你的熟食时，你必须小心，因为它以前发生在我身上。

segments.en: You know, you come in with all the clothes and then you have stretched out boxers or something like that.
segments.zh: 你知道，你带着所有的衣服进来，然后你伸出了拳击手或类似的东西。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So that's why many women, I know, wash delicates by hand.
segments.zh: 所以这就是为什么许多女人，我知道，用手洗熟食。

segments.en: So you separate the clothes from the delicates.
segments.zh: 所以你把衣服和熟食分开。

segments.en: Very good.
segments.zh: 很好。

segments.en: And now if you're washing delicates or you're washing towels or t-shirts, it's always a good idea to use fabric softener.
segments.zh: 现在，如果您正在清洗熟食或正在洗毛巾或 T 恤，使用织物柔软剂总是一个好主意。

segments.en: All right, fabric softener.
segments.zh: 好的，织物柔软剂。

segments.en: What are these two words?
segments.zh: 这两个词是什么？

segments.en: One of them you understand already.
segments.zh: 您已经了解其中之一。

segments.en: Maybe it's soft, softener.
segments.zh: 也许它是柔软的，柔软剂。

segments.en: So it makes it soft.
segments.zh: 所以它使它变得柔软。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Something that makes something softer.
segments.zh: 使某物更柔软的东西。

segments.en: We've got fabric softener.
segments.zh: 我们有织物柔软剂。

segments.en: It's something that makes the clothes that you wash softer.
segments.zh: 它使你洗的衣服更柔软。

segments.en: So fabric is any type of material, right?
segments.zh: 所以面料是任何类型的材料，对吧？

segments.en: Like a textile.
segments.zh: 像纺织品。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So it could be cotton or silk or nylon, linen.
segments.zh: 所以它可以是棉、丝绸或尼龙、亚麻布。

segments.en: So these are all kinds of fabrics.
segments.zh: 所以这些都是各种面料。

segments.en: So you pour a little bit of this in your washing machine and your clothes come out really nice and soft.
segments.zh: 所以你在洗衣机里倒了一点，你的衣服出来真的又好又软。

segments.en: It feels nice just talking about it.
segments.zh: 光是谈论它就感觉很好。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: And well, also to wash your clothes, to actually make them clean, you use detergent.
segments.zh: 好吧，还要洗你的衣服，要真正让它们干净，你就用洗涤剂。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: So many people might want to say the word soap because soap is what we use to wash our hands and our dishes.
segments.zh: 很多人可能想说肥皂这个词，因为肥皂是我们用来洗手和洗碗的东西。

segments.en: But here we have detergent.
segments.zh: 但在这里我们有洗涤剂。

segments.en: So this is a special soap for your clothes.
segments.zh: 所以这是适合你衣服的特殊肥皂。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: Laundry detergent.
segments.zh: 洗衣粉。

segments.en: Yeah.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You could just say laundry.
segments.zh: 你可以说洗衣服。

segments.en: You could say laundry detergent or simply detergent.
segments.zh: 你可以说洗衣粉或只是洗涤剂。

segments.en: And now in order to remove those nasty stains that maybe are very hard, you would use a chemical called bleach.
segments.zh: 现在为了去除那些可能非常坚硬的讨厌的污渍，你会使用一种叫做漂白剂的化学物质。

segments.en: All right.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So bleach is the dangerous chemical because it smells very strong.
segments.zh: 所以漂白剂是危险的化学物质，因为它闻起来很浓。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: And it can change the color of your clothes to white or yellow.
segments.zh: 它可以将您的衣服颜色更改为白色或黄色。

segments.en: So we usually only use bleach with white clothes.
segments.zh: 所以我们通常只用白衣服的漂白剂。

segments.en: I actually had a friend who changed the color of his hair to white using bleach.
segments.zh: 实际上，我有一个朋友使用漂白剂将他的头发颜色改为白色。

segments.en: He put bleach on his head and on his hair and it just turned white.
segments.zh: 他把漂白剂放在他的头和头发上，它就变成了白色。

segments.en: Oh, wow.
segments.zh: 哦，哇。

segments.en: So many people do that because they want to go from dark colors to light colors.
segments.zh: 很多人这样做是因为他们想从深色变成浅色。

segments.en: And in that case, you wouldn't say, you could say that he dyed his hair white, but usually you would say he bleached his hair.
segments.zh: 在这种情况下，你不会说，你可以说他把头发染成了白色，但通常你会说他漂白了头发。

segments.en: And so we understand that it turned white.
segments.zh: 所以我们明白它变成了白色。

segments.en: Exactly.
segments.zh: 正是这样。

segments.en: So those five words we just looked at in language takeaway, they're important.
segments.zh: 所以我们刚刚在语言外卖中看到的那五个词，它们很重要。

segments.en: They're related to doing laundry.
segments.zh: 它们与洗衣有关。

segments.en: So before we move on, let's listen to our dialogue again, but a little bit slower.
segments.zh: 所以在我们继续之前，让我们再听一次我们的对话，但慢一点。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: Let's go through this one more time.
segments.zh: 让我们再来一次。

segments.en: I don't want any more ruined or dyed blouses.
segments.zh: 我可不想再把衬衫洗坏或染上别的颜色了。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.en: I know.
segments.zh: 我知道。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: So I have to separate the colors from the whites and put them in this strange looking contraption so-called washing machine.
segments.zh: 所以我必须将颜色与白色分开，并将它们放在这个看起来很奇怪的装置中，所谓的洗衣机。

segments.en: Right.
segments.zh: 对。

segments.en: You have to turn it on and program it depending on what type of clothes you are washing.
segments.zh: 您必须打开它并根据您要洗的衣服类型对其进行编程。

segments.en: For example, for delicates, you should set a shorter washing cycle.
segments.zh: 比如洗精细衣物时，应该选择较短的洗涤程序。

segments.en: Also, be sure to use fabric softener and this detergent when washing.
segments.zh: 另外，洗涤时一定要使用织物柔软剂和这种洗涤剂。

segments.en: So complicated.
segments.zh: 太复杂了。

segments.en: Okay.
segments.zh: 好的。

segments.en: What about this red wine stain?
segments.zh: 这个红酒污渍怎么办？

segments.en: How do I get it out?
segments.zh: 我怎么把它拿出来？

segments.en: Since this is a white t-shirt, you can just pour a little bit of bleach on it and it will do the trick.
segments.zh: 因为这是一件白色的 T 恤，你可以在上面倒一点漂白剂，它就可以了。

segments.en: Cool.
